note: The journalist's review of the claims in the evidence vault that are not in the site's claim table (data/claims.json). One row per reviewed claim: the verdict (used, agrees, held back), the reason, and the page it was reviewed for. A vault claim with no row here is shown on /claims/review/ as not yet reviewed, so a new export lists new claims without anyone editing a page.

verdicts.used: used on a page, attributed to its source
verdicts.agrees: agrees with a claim the site already carries; not repeated
verdicts.held back: not stated on the site as worded, for the reason given
verdicts.noted: recorded and checked against its page, not used on a page yet; nothing on the site contradicts it
